status: D1 dependency-source availability and construction contracts closed; deployed/runtime equivalence open

Account.conclusion: Reject zero-lamport system-owned input, require T::owner(), then T::try_deserialize. No implied PDA or role link. Box delegates. Unchecked initializer deserialization retains owner check, skips discriminator via T. Custom Mayhem codecs remain the concrete T contract.

Signer.conclusion: Consumes one account and checks is_signer only; does not imply writable, System ownership, or role membership.

Program.conclusion: Require T ID except when T::id()==Pubkey::default(); always require executable. Thus System ID needs Mayhem custom wrapper. Nonzero Token2022, AssociatedToken, Mayhem types enforce fixed IDs.

CheckedSystemProgram.conclusion: Explicit System ID check precedes Program executable check; composite exit is no-op and duplicate key list empty.

Interface.conclusion: CheckId membership then executable; TokenInterface allows legacy SPL and Token2022. A separate address constraint can narrow the set.

InterfaceAccount.conclusion: CheckOwner membership then T deserialize; token wrappers accept both program owners and unpack initialized base state with extension framing, retain base only. No automatic equality to a separate token_program account and no complete TLV extension-policy validation. Reload repeats membership + deserialize.

UncheckedAccount.conclusion: Consumes AccountInfo only; constraints explicitly attached to field still apply. No implicit owner, discriminator, executable or signer check.

codec.conclusion: Nonzero-copy account macro emits discriminator prefix check then AnchorDeserialize, serialize writes discriminator+fields; owner for default namespace is crate ID. This does not override custom codecs. No trailing-data exhaustion assertion in this generated deserialize path.

order.conclusion: Derive consumes fields in declaration order; init fields initially raw. Init constraints run before duplicate checks, then non-init field constraints. Per field order: zero/init/realloc/seeds/ATA/mut/signer/has_one/raw/owner/rent/executable/close/address/token/mint. Handler only after parsing; exit only after handler returns Ok. This is source construction, not an executed expansion or rollback proof.

mut.conclusion: Require is_writable. init and init_if_needed imply mut through parser.

seeds.conclusion: Bare bump uses find_program_address and caches canonical bump; explicit bump uses create_program_address. seeds::program replaces executing program for derivation. Equality to derived key enforced. Seeds alone do not check owner/data.

has_one.conclusion: Compare stored named field to target.key; Signer validation is independent.

address.conclusion: Compare account key to exact declared expression; address alone does not imply executable.

token.conclusion: token::authority compares token data owner; token::mint compares data mint; token::token_program compares AccountInfo owner, only when each is specified. No included Mayhem field declares this group; ATA is a distinct group.

ATA.conclusion: Non-init ATA: compare AccountInfo owner to explicit associated_token::token_program; compare token data owner to authority; compare key to ATA PDA derived from authority, token program and mint. It does NOT separately compare token data mint. Authentic creation invariants and downstream token logic remain external. Every included ATA field specifies token program.

init.conclusion: Parser implies mut and rent enforcement; canonical PDA init uses current program and caches bump. Program-owned init creates/funds+allocates+assigns via System then unchecked typed deserialize; discriminator persists on exit. Existing funded accounts take allocate/assign path. No automatic authorization relationship to a field called admin.

ATA_init.conclusion: ATA init invokes associated_token::create (not create_idempotent), then unchecked typed deserialize. init_if_needed enters create when AccountInfo owner is System; otherwise deserialize existing. if_needed explicitly checks stored mint, authority, token program owner and canonical ATA key. Parser also implies mut/rent enforcement.

realloc.conclusion: Generic realloc macro prevents duplicate reallocs, bounds growth, funds rent or refunds shrink excess and invokes resize. No included Mayhem field has realloc attribute: extend_account manually funds and resizes. Do not import generated realloc guard to that handler.

duplicate.conclusion: Generated set includes mutable Account/LazyAccount/InterfaceAccount/Migration except dup and pure init; init_if_needed remains included. Signer, UncheckedAccount and AccountLoader not included. Composite keys collected. No remaining_accounts scan. Per-context candidate lists below are static substitutions of this filter, not runtime collision findings.

exit.conclusion: Mutable fields get AccountsExit; composite exit delegates. Account serializes only when expected owner equals executing program and not closed. InterfaceAccount uses originally captured owner; external SPL accounts are not serialized by Mayhem. remaining_accounts not auto-exited. sweep explicitly exits each FeeRecipient.

event.conclusion: emit logs serialized discriminator+event; emit_cpi targets crate::ID with only event_authority signer meta, uses constant event bump and does not read ctx.accounts.program. Event dispatch checks signer and fixed authority key. Generic event_cpi attribute injects address=constant (despite older seed-based doc example); Mayhem declares explicit seeds+bump fields instead. Nontrade unchecked program field has no implicit target check; six trade Program<Mayhem> fields independently do.

transfer.conclusion: anchor_spl::token::transfer hardcodes legacy SPL ID; ctx.program_id is unused. Constructs writable source/destination and signer authority, no multisig signers; invokes with signer seeds. Applies to withdraw_quote_admin and sweep_remaining. Passing Token2022 Interface does not select Token2022 transfer.

burn.conclusion: token_interface reexports token_2022 burn: target is ctx.program_id; instruction constructor permits legacy or Token2022, writable from+mint, signer authority, supplied signer seeds. Does not itself execute token account/mint relationship or extension checks; those belong to callee.

boxed.conclusion: Box delegates try_accounts and exit to its inner type; it does not replace InterfaceAccount owner-set checks with Account single-owner checks.

system_CPI.conclusion: System wrappers construct fixed System instructions and pass the relevant account infos and ctx.signer_seeds to invoke_signed. They do not use ctx.program_id to select arbitrary targets; actual debit/assign/allocate rules and rollback belong to System/runtime.

reload.conclusion: Account reload rechecks T owner and concrete T deserializer; InterfaceAccount reload rechecks owner membership and concrete T decoder. Neither reruns context seed/ATA/has_one constraints.
